relationships.description: Moiraine holds the Warder bond with Lan; she heals his wounds repeatedly during the journey
Tension between them; Lan avoids looking at Nynaeve; she calls out to him when he's in danger; Egwene glares at Lan after observing Nynaeve
Egwene shows concern for Nynaeve; they have a private conversation; Nynaeve reassures Egwene; they share an experience related to the True Source
The Green Man greets Loial as 'little brother' and 'Treebrother'; shows affection by putting his arm around Loial; speaks of singing Tree Songs together
The Green Man recognizes Perrin as a Wolfbrother; Perrin tries to avoid his gaze
The Green Man calls Rand 'Child of the Dragon' and speaks of the 'People of the Dragon' and the 'first Covenant', though he cannot explain what he means due to his damaged memories
Lan rides Mandarb; the warhorse is wounded in combat and healed by Moiraine
Rand rides the bay horse Red
